<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.1153, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 140.108 Da. The formula that best matches this mass within typical experimental error and contains only C, H, and O atoms is C₅H₁₆O₄ (exact mass 140.1049 Da). This is the most plausible molecular formula for the compound.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H16O4</final_answer>
